title: Introduce shadow-sanity gating and per-prompt scorecards for canary rollouts
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Add a lightweight "sanity gate" that evaluates shadow-mirrored traffic against a golden prompt set and per-prompt scorecards before allowing canary promotion. This ticket builds the infra to (1) run eval prompt sets continuously on shadowed requests, (2) compute per-prompt and aggregate quality deltas, (3) apply gating logic with configurable thresholds and statistical tests, and (4) integrate result-based auto-rollback with existing rollout service. This is different from full eval automation: the gate is designed to be low-latency, robust to noise, and suitable for live traffic mirroring (5-10% sample).
acceptance_criteria: Shadow traffic mirror runs the golden prompt set and live sample—results ingested to eval pipeline within < 2 minutes of request completion
Per-prompt scorecards computed and stored with schema compatible with console rollouts dashboard
Gating engine evaluates aggregate delta, per-prompt regressions, and statistical significance (paired bootstrap) and returns a pass/fail decision within configured gating window
When gate fails during canary, rollout service triggers auto-rollback policy: immediate rollback if high-severity regression, or staged halt + alert for medium severity
Integration tests added: simulated shadow traffic with injected regressions triggers expected gate decisions and rollback actions
Documentation and runbook created: how to tune thresholds, interpret per-prompt failures, and debug false positives
technical_notes: Golden prompt set v2: 120 prompts across high-risk families (SQL, instruction-following, tokenization edge cases, structured JSON outputs)
Scorecard metrics: exact-match (where applicable), normalized BLEU, semantic-similarity (embedding cosine), and custom validators for structured outputs
Significance test: paired bootstrap over prompt-level metric deltas with 1000 resamples — default alpha=0.05. Provide option for Holm-Bonferroni correction for multiple prompts
Traffic sampling: mirror 5% of production request volume to the eval runner; fallback to offline batch if rate-limited
Storage: results written to 'rollouts-eval' time-series index with tags: model, model_version, route, prompt_id, scorecard_id
Gate decision engine exposes REST webhook consumed by rollout-controller; decision payload is flat JSON summary (pass/fail, top 10 failing prompts, aggregate delta, p-value)
decisions: Use shadow-mirroring (mirror) instead of active A/B routing for initial low-risk gating to avoid user impact
Adopt per-prompt thresholds by severity bucket (critical, important, cosmetic) rather than a single global threshold
Prefer paired bootstrap over t-test because distributions of deltas are non-normal and prompts have varying variance
Keep default mirror sampling at 5% with quick path to 1% or 10% toggles in config for noise control
